akvan.deck: Severe Cyclone Akvan bears down on India's east coast; schools shut in six districts, trains rescheduled, IMD warns of heavy rain.
akvan.headline: Cyclone Akvan bears down
akvan.map_caption: CYCLONE AKVAN — BAY OF BENGAL, THU 19 NOV

anthropic.deck: Claude-maker Anthropic begins trading on Nasdaq today under ticker ANT, priced at $83 — an $81.3bn raise, the biggest IPO ever, valuing it near $1.5tn.
anthropic.headline: Anthropic debuts at $1.5tn

footer: Sources: Reuters · AP · NYT · BBC · NASA · IMD · Sensor Tower — all visuals drawn for this page; no wire photographs.

gta.deck: After 13 years, Rockstar's return to Vice City unlocks at midnight local time on PS5 and Xbox — about 16m copies pre-sold for $1.5bn; a 212GB download.
gta.headline: GTA VI launches at midnight

kerch.deck: A third attack overnight hit the railway span, which had survived two earlier strikes; the road span fell into the sea on Tuesday. Traffic is halted.
kerch.diagram_caption: THE KERCH BRIDGE — RAIL SPAN HIT OVERNIGHT
kerch.headline: Bridge hit a third time

lead.deck: Xi hugged Trump on the tarmac as he arrived for the APEC summit; the three hold a trilateral with Putin on Thursday — as Kerch is hit a third time.
lead.headline: THREE LEADERS, ONE TABLE
lead.visual_caption: THE THREE FLAGS OVER SHENZHEN — THE U.S., CHINA AND RUSSIA MEET AT THE APEC SUMMIT
